answer: Orchard yield-table bond: each identity tends an orchard tree and logs its nectar in a public table anyone can recompute. Each crate carries a pigment seal bound to its tree, auditor-checked; a pigment mismatch burns the 45-credit bond; a borrowed-tree ring fails the same check. Forging 1,000 identities costs 53,000: 1,000 seals at 8 plus 45,000 locked, against a 40,000 pool: net loss. An honest agent pays one seal and keeps its nectar undiluted.
